title: VERIFY-1: runtime monitors for the two invariants with model checks only
body:
**Owner:** executor
**Trigger:** ops/verification.json coverage share < 1.0
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation verify --check
**Status:** done
**Evidence:** `python3 -m foundation verify --report` prints 9/9 invariants model-checked and tied to code; seed/worker conformance via scripts/verify.py (ultrastable/seed#10, #11); /verification and /api/verification served from site/verification-data.js.

`lane-retries-bounded` and `essential-steps-every-tick` (doctrine/verification.json) are model-checked but not tied to code. Add a check over seed/worker/src/sweeper.js retry counts and a tick-step assertion that measure, reconcile, dispatch, merge and deploy ran each non-halted tick, then set `monitor` on both rows. Also lift foundation/verify.py into the seed so every tenant inherits it, and render ops/verification.json on /live.

size: M

**Closing probe:** `python3 -m foundation verify --report` prints 9/9.
